title: ToolRL: Reward is All Tool Learning Needs -- Reproduction
description: This artifact reproduces ToolRL (Qian et al., "ToolRL: Reward is All Tool Learning Needs", arXiv:2504.13958, 2025) on the verl framework using Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-3B base models. We trained 11 model cells covering GRPO and PPO with both cold-start and warm-start (SFT400) initialization, then evaluated all 11 cells on API-Bank (597 questions) and 5 cells on BFCL V4. We successfully replicated the paper's qualitative conclusion that GRPO cold-start outperforms PPO and that warm-start hurts smaller models; our absolute numbers differ from the paper by 3-16 percentage points, which we attribute to RL training variance. Our independent contributions are a parser bug we found and fixed in the paper's API-Bank evaluation script (verified byte-for-byte against the authors' public repo), and a documented format-collapse mechanism in 3B warm-start models. The provisioning notebook reproduce.ipynb runs on a Chameleon KVM@TACC H100 instance and executes one demo training step end-to-end so a reader can verify the full pipeline works before scaling up.
